messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Jonathan,

The agreed final version is now ready for signature, reflecting the 9-month non-compete, £110,000 ex gratia and £2,500+VAT fees contribution. Please arrange for your client to sign and for you to complete the adviser's certificate. Daniel Pryce will sign for the Group. We're aiming to date it 27 March with termination on 31 March.

Kind regards,
